offering_description.value: Sells financial management software and online services for individuals, self-employed people, small businesses and accounting professionals, covering tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, payments and personal finance. Mainly delivered as cloud software and online subscriptions, with assisted services added on top.

primary_products.value: tax preparation software; small business accounting software; payroll software; payments and invoicing tools; personal finance apps

primary_services.value: assisted tax preparation; payroll processing; bookkeeping services; online financial product referrals

customer_segment.value: B2B: small businesses, self-employed people, accounting firms and bookkeepers; B2C: individual taxpayers and consumers managing personal finances

end_markets.value: small business software; tax preparation; personal finance; payroll; digital marketing

revenue_model.value: subscription: software subscriptions for accounting, payroll, payments and tax products; service fees: fees for assisted tax preparation and payroll services; transaction or usage fees: payment processing fees charged on customer transactions; advertising: referral and advertising fees from lending and financial product partners
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; transaction or usage fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud financial software platforms sold to consumers and businesses; service provider: assisted tax and payroll services sold to individuals and small businesses; financial intermediary: connects consumers with lenders and card issuers for referral fees
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: mainly the US, plus Canada, the UK, Australia, India and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: small business accounting, tax preparation, payroll, payments, personal finance and marketing software

distribution_channels.value: online: direct web and app sales of software and subscriptions; direct sales: sales teams selling to mid-sized and larger business accounts; partners / resellers: accounting professionals and ProAdvisor-certified advisors who recommend and resell products

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: tax filing rules from the IRS, consumer protection and data privacy rules, and CFPB oversight of lending referrals
